data.name: Unmesh
data.gender_notes: Unmesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Originating from the Sanskrit root word ‘un-’ meaning ‘to open’ or ‘to unfold’, and ‘mesh’ meaning ‘the thread or fabric of the universe’, Unmesh is a name that signifies the emergence or unfolding of a new life or a new beginning. The name Unmesh carries the meaning “Emerging, or unfolding” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Unmesh usually hope their child will grow to embody emerging, or unfolding and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the continuous process of creation and evolution in the universe.
data.etymology: Unmesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Emerging, or unfolding.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Unmesh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
